tasks.title: N-coupled public-effective resource coverage or admissible escape classification
tasks.frontier: The accepted G_effect-dist^eff theorem externalizes every oracle-free fully public effective probabilistic generative semantics and computably enumerates terminal support for the frozen effective branching classes. The remaining question is whether every operational resource admissible to the public-N N-coupled objective lies inside that class, or whether one explicit admissible resource survives outside it without secrecy, hidden factor authority, noncomputable or physical oracles, asymmetric model privilege, or a reviewed classical factor mechanism.
tasks.next_action: Freeze the admissible operational-resource vocabulary of the N-coupled objective, prove a coverage theorem into G_effect-dist^eff or exhibit one exact admissible escape resource outside it, and adversarially classify every escape against oracle, secrecy, model-privilege, direct-nonunit and inherited classical-mechanism firewalls.

successor_gate.new_information_gap: The parent Result closes distributional hiding for a broad public effective execution class, but it does not prove that the parent objective admits no operational resources outside that class. The new information gap is exact coverage of the objective's admissible resource vocabulary, not another example of hidden randomness.
successor_gate.why_parent_result_does_not_close_it: G_effect-dist^eff is a theorem about a frozen effective semantics. Parent-objective closure requires a separate argument that every admissible public-N operational resource is represented by that semantics, or an exact classification of any admissible resource that is not.
discriminating_outcomes: a coverage theorem maps every admissible public-N operational resource in the declared objective scope into G_effect-dist^eff and therefore yields an exact parent-closure candidate for the nonclassical delayed-support route at that scope

one explicit fully specified admissible resource lies outside G_effect-dist^eff while remaining public, oracle-free, nonsecret and symmetrically available to runtime and external analysis, creating a new typed mechanism frontier

every apparent escape is reduced to secrecy, hidden factor authority, noncomputable or physical oracle access, asymmetric model privilege, direct nonunit search or an inherited classical factor mechanism and is rejected

the objective's admissible-resource vocabulary is under-specified, so exact coverage is undecidable from the current statement and the minimum semantic specification gap is frozen instead of inventing an escape
successor_gate.kill_condition: Reject any escape whose extra power is secret implementation or environment state, hidden p/q or factor-correlated input, noncomputable or physical oracle access, a resource granted to runtime but arbitrarily denied to the external interpreter, direct randomized nonunit search, or a reviewed order/smoothness, collision/cycle, square-relation or named-prime p-adic mechanism.
successor_gate.alternative_route_or_free_exploration_co: Further generic effect, randomness or nondeterminism searches were considered and rejected because the accepted parent theorem already externalizes the fully public effective class. The higher-value alternative is to test whether that theorem covers the admissible resource model itself.
successor_gate.why_new_stage_or_task_is_better_than_sam: Immediate closure would overclaim because resource coverage has not been proved, while continuing the same distributional-effect task would repeat a closed semantic class. A dedicated coverage-or-escape classification supplies the missing bridge between the theorem class and the parent objective.

tasks.research_value: This is the missing bridge between the accepted public-effective externalization theorem and any legitimate parent-objective closure; it prevents both endless effect repackaging and premature universal no-go claims.
tasks.mother_question:
Does the public-`N` N-coupled asymmetric-singularization objective permit any operational resource outside the accepted `G_effect-dist^eff` class, once secrecy, hidden factor authority, noncomputable or physical oracles, asymmetric model privilege and reviewed classical factor mechanisms are excluded?

Equivalently, can the current sequence of exact scalarization/externalization theorems be upgraded from a theorem about successively frozen grammars to a coverage theorem for the admissible public algorithmic resource model, or is there one concrete admissible escape that deserves a new typed mechanism task?
tasks.research_value_to_preserve:
The N-coupled line has successively separated ring-term behavior, unimodular support preservation, explicit-presentation scalarization, extensional reflection, intensional public-trace compilation, hidden-branch opacity, seed-law externalization and finally general public-effective distributional externalization.

The remaining uncertainty is no longer "can a more opaque program hide support?" It is whether the parent objective's admissible resource model contains anything outside the public effective semantics already proved externally reproducible.

A coverage theorem would convert a long sequence of local negative boundaries into a scoped closure result without overclaiming universal factoring impossibility. An exact escape would be equally valuable because it would identify the first genuinely new semantic resource in this line rather than another representation-level disguise. A specification-gap result would prevent false closure and make the missing assumption explicit.

gate_decisions.reason: The frozen-class distributional negative does not cover the full parent resource language. Preserve the same existing coverage Task ID/owner through its exact prospective Gen2, including coverage, admissible-escape and specification-gap alternatives.

The current reused interpreter/dovetail boundary is elementary and no L4 or new formal library payload is claimed. The next unresolved interface is the exact admissible-resource model, retained in the mathematical continuation.

The actual reviewed return explicitly preserves original theorem authorship, makes no new novelty claim and audits candidate mechanisms against the frozen classical/direct-nonunit firewall. This satisfies the comparison duty for the present negative class result; it neither restores old Driver authority nor classifies all externalizable algorithms as classical. Any future positive coverage/escape claim retains its own comparison obligations.

The mathematical judgment is by explicit interpreter/pushforward and fair-prefix/branch dovetail proofs. Existing finite checks are distinguished as historical regression, not a new authenticated replication. Repeating old checker/samples does not discharge a new required obligation.
RESULT_ONLY evidence reuse introduces no new general-purpose code/tool family. Existing exact contract and sources remain pinned; no integration Task is required for this boundary.

The current Result explicitly tests the frozen theorem against hidden factors, secret code, unmodelled oracle/random resources, branch-opacity confusion and unsafe marginal-to-joint/efficiency inferences. This satisfies audit of this class theorem only. The complete coverage Task still requires adversarial rejection/classification of all proposed escapes and all seven admissibility conditions; those future obligations are not marked complete here.
